traits.name: Draconic Ancestry
traits.description: Choose one type of dragon. Your breath weapon and damage resistance are determined by the dragon type.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.description: You can use your action to exhale destructive energy. Each creature in the area must make a saving throw. The DC is 8 + Constitution modifier + proficiency bonus. Damage is 2d6 at 1st level, increasing as you level.

traits.name: Damage Resistance
traits.description: You have resistance to the damage type associated with your draconic ancestry.

traits.name: Gnome Cunning
traits.description: Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

traits.name: Artificer's Lore
traits.description: Whenever you make an Intelligence (History) check related to magic items, alchemical objects, or technological devices, add twice your proficiency bonus.

traits.name: Tinker
traits.description: You have proficiency with artisan's tools (tinker's tools). You can spend 1 hour and 10 gp to construct a Tiny clockwork device.

traits.name: Gnome Cunning
traits.description: Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

traits.name: Natural Illusionist
traits.description: You know the Minor Illusion cantrip. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability.

traits.name: Speak with Small Beasts
traits.description: You can communicate simple ideas with Small or smaller beasts through sounds and gestures.

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: +2 Charisma, and two other ability scores of your choice increase by 1.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: Advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.

traits.name: Skill Versatility
traits.description: Proficiency in two skills of your choice.

traits.name: Menacing
traits.description: Proficiency in Intimidation.

traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.description: When reduced to 0 HP but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 HP instead. You can't use this feature again until you finish a long rest.

traits.name: Savage Attacks
traits.description: When you score a critical hit with a melee weapon attack, you can roll one of the weapon's damage dice one additional time and add it to the extra damage.

traits.name: Hellish Resistance
traits.description: Resistance to fire damage.

traits.name: Infernal Legacy
traits.description: You know the Thaumaturgy cantrip. At 3rd level, you can cast Hellish Rebuke once per day. At 5th level, you can also cast Darkness once per day. Charisma is your spellcasting ability.

traits.name: Flight
traits.description: You have a flying speed of 50 feet. You can't use this if you're wearing medium or heavy armor.

traits.name: Talons
traits.description: Your talons are natural weapons, which you can use to make unarmed strikes. On hit, they deal 1d4 + Strength modifier slashing damage.

traits.name: Fire Resistance
traits.description: Resistance to fire damage.

traits.name: Reach to the Blaze
traits.description: You know the Produce Flame cantrip. At 3rd level, you can cast Burning Hands once per day as a 1st-level spell. Constitution is your spellcasting ability.

traits.name: Acid Resistance
traits.description: Resistance to acid damage.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: You can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Swim
traits.description: You have a swimming speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Call to the Wave
traits.description: You know the Shape Water cantrip. At 3rd level, you can cast Create or Destroy Water once per day as a 2nd-level spell. Constitution is your spellcasting ability.

traits.name: Unending Breath
traits.description: You can hold your breath indefinitely while you're not incapacitated.

traits.name: Mingle with the Wind
traits.description: You can cast Levitate once per day without requiring a material component. Constitution is your spellcasting ability.

traits.name: Earth Walk
traits.description: You can move across difficult terrain made of earth or stone without expending extra movement.

traits.name: Merge with Stone
traits.description: You can cast Pass Without Trace once per day without requiring a material component. Constitution is your spellcasting ability.

traits.name: Natural Athlete
traits.description: Proficiency in Athletics.

traits.name: Stone's Endurance
traits.description: You can use your reaction to reduce damage by 1d12 + Constitution modifier. You can't use this again until you finish a short or long rest.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.description: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

traits.name: Mountain Born
traits.description: You're acclimated to high altitude and naturally adapted to cold climates.

traits.name: Feline Agility
traits.description: When you move on your turn in combat, you can double your speed until the end of the turn. Once used, you can't use it again until you move 0 feet on one of your turns.

traits.name: Cat's Claws
traits.description: Your claws are natural weapons. You can use them to make unarmed strikes. On hit, they deal 1d4 + Strength modifier slashing damage. You also have a climbing speed of 20 feet.

traits.name: Cat's Talent
traits.description: Proficiency in Perception and Stealth.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: You can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Swim
traits.description: You have a swimming speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Control Air and Water
traits.description: You can cast Fog Cloud once per day. At 3rd level, you can cast Gust of Wind once per day. At 5th level, you can cast Wall of Water once per day. Charisma is your spellcasting ability.

traits.name: Emissary of the Sea
traits.description: You can communicate simple ideas with beasts that can breathe water.

traits.name: Guardians of the Depths
traits.description: Adapted to the ocean depths, you have resistance to cold damage.
